'''The Happiness Clover''' (Japanese: '''幸せのクローバー''' ''Clover of Happiness'') is the fifty-sixth chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Hazel]] wants a four-leaf clover, so {{MPJ|Pikachu}} and {{MPJ|Clefairy}} find her one. But a {{p|Totodile}} tricks them into giving it to him, since he bet his friends he could find one. Can the two scatterbrains possibly find another?
